name: goblin-archivist
description: Connects Claude Code sessions on this Mac to one Obsidian vault. This first slice ships /goblin-archivist:sniff-vault, a read-only survey of the vault that reports what is there and drafts a schema; nothing is written to the vault.

enabled.title: Archivist on
enabled.description: The one switch for all of it. Off, the mod registers nothing and every archivist skill stops before it reads the vault.

vault.title: Vault
vault.description: The Obsidian vault the archivist reads. Left empty, sniff-vault lists the vaults Obsidian knows and asks which.

base_folder.title: Archivist folder
base_folder.description: Where the archivist writes its own files on this machine, outside the vault: one subfolder per project, named after the repository, and vault/ for vault-wide reports. Nothing runs until this is set.
